description: This Java class defines the configuration for custom shipping quotes within an e-commerce system, including module code, regions, and a method to serialize the data to JSON.

classes.name: CustomShippingQuotesConfiguration
classes.description: A configuration class for custom shipping quotes, extending integration configuration, with JSON serialization.

methods.name: toJSONString
methods.description: Serializes the configuration data to a JSON string, including module code, active status, and regions.

methods.name: getModuleCode
methods.description: Returns the module code identifying this shipping configuration.

methods.name: setModuleCode
methods.description: Sets the module code for this shipping configuration.

methods.name: getRegions
methods.description: Returns the list of regions associated with this shipping configuration.

methods.name: setRegions
methods.description: Sets the list of regions for this shipping configuration.
